cohort: 150 pregnant women with singleton term pregnancies and evidence of meconium-stained amniotic fluid during labor.
finding: Thick meconium-stained amniotic fluid was significantly associated with adverse neonatal outcomes, including lower APGAR scores, higher NICU admissions, and increased Meconium Aspiration Syndrome, compared to thin meconium.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean delivery was significantly higher in the thick meconium group compared to the thin meconium group.
